summary: Revised implementation plan: Zero buttons deleted! All 9 functional buttons (Trip Calculator, Vehicle Account/Ledger, Motorway Toll, Map & Route Weather, Dashcam Recorder, Vehicles Verification, License Verification, E-Challan Check, and More Services/Quick Ops) are preserved 100%. Re-architected into an ergonomic, responsive 2-row app launcher layout. Calendar and wisdom box removed from HomeView to eliminate multi-screen scroll fatigue. Owner Control Panel remains strictly preserved for authorized owner only.
